findings.claim: Four B12 tuning constants are exported but nothing in src/, tests/, harness/, guardrails/ or spikes/ imports them. Each is used only inside its own module, so the `export` keyword makes the sim's internal surface look wider than it is.
findings.evidence: src/sim/pickups.ts:10 `export const PICKUP_RADIUS = 2.5;` (used only at :48), :12 `export const PICKUP_RESPAWN_TICKS = 300;` (only :50), :14 `export const BOOST_TICKS = 90;` (only :38); src/sim/car.ts:40 `export const BOOST_TOP_SPEED = 32;` (only :42-43 in BOOSTED). A repo-wide grep for `\b(PICKUP_RADIUS|PICKUP_RESPAWN_TICKS|BOOST_TICKS|BOOST_TOP_SPEED)\b` outside node_modules finds only those lines plus the header comments pickups.ts:4-6 and car.ts:271. None of them is re-exported by src/sim/index.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Drop the `export` keyword from the four declarations and leave the values and comments alone. This changes only the module surface, not runtime values. Open PR #35 (B13) edits both pickups.ts and car.ts, and its new tests (tests/sim/rival-boost.test.ts, rival-helpers.ts) may import these constants. Apply this only after #35 lands, and only to the names that are still unimported after a fresh grep.

confirmations.note: The five hand-written positive-modulo wraps are still in src/sim/track.ts. Their lines moved: :303 `points[((i % n) + n) % n]`, :453 `((s % t.length) + t.length) % t.length`, :485 `((segment % track.count) + track.count) % track.count`, :521 `((hintSeg % n) + n) % n`, :528 `(((centre + o) % n) + n) % n`.
Still fixed. validateTrack builds each prop row once, at track.ts:226 (`return { kind: k, side, from, to, spacing, offset } as const`), and returns `propRows` directly at :256 with no second spread.

The claim no longer holds. CAR_LENGTH comes in through the barrel (src/render/car.ts:11), and so do encodeInputs, decodeInputs and replayInputs (tests/sim/pickup-replay.test.ts:3-17). Only nextRange, nextInt, Rng, Replay and WorldOptions are still unimported through it, and the barrel is the documented sole entry point.
